brief:
Knesset member Maha Karkobi has warned of escalating crime in Palestinian communities inside 1948 occupied territories, the Shehab Wire reported. She stated that more than 80 percent of murder cases go unsolved amid hundreds of thousands of illegal firearms circulating in the region.

Karkobi's warning highlights the security crisis facing Palestinian citizens of Israel, where weapons proliferation has contributed to rising violence and a backlog of unresolved homicides.

title: Over 80% of murders in occupied 1948 territories remain unsolved, lawmaker warns
